messages:
maya: Heads-up: Acme wants SSO + org-admin + an audit-search in the pilot. They tied pilot acceptance to those three. We need a path: keep date and cut other things, take +1 week, or stage audit UI to v1.

sam: Quick est: SSO + bare admin is doable with current work, audit-search UI is the risky piece (~2w FE + infra). Backend audit capture is cheap (~3-4d).

leo: Ops note: whatever we ship needs a feature flag + rollback plan. That adds ~1d. QA needs a 72h smoke window.

anya: Commercial: Acme will accept a 1-week slip if we commit to audit UI delivered in v1 with a signed ETA. They prefer no delay but can tolerate +1.

jin: Design can drop to a minimal audit UI (search + table) reusing components; that reduces FE time. I can deliver mocks in 2 working days.

cs-rep: Support impact if we ship without audit UI is moderate; customers expect traceability for admin actions. Server-side logs mitigate risk.

maya: Proposed decision rule: if Acme accepts server-side audit capture + signed v1 ETA -> take +1 week and apply cutlist. If they insist on audit UI for pilot -> push +2 weeks. @anya please confirm with Acme by EOD.

sam: Proposed cutlist to free ~2w if needed: defer promptstore analytics, tenant tagging UI, onboarding tours. Low customer impact for pilot.

anya: Pinging Acme now. Ill request the signed commitment option and a 1-week buffer. Will report back.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created flag feature/pilot-acme and scheduled canary at 2143808120

anya: Acme replied: they accept server-side logs + signed audit-ui ETA if we give +1 week. They want the ETA in writing.

maya: Decision: accept +1 week, apply the cutlist, capture audit events server-side now, and deliver audit UI in v1 by the committed date. Sam and Leo will update roadmap and release plan. Action items:
- sam: update RDW-3412 timeline and code-freeze.
- leo: land audit capture and feature-flag, prep rollback by EOD tomorrow.
- jin: deliver minimal audit UI mocks in 48h.
- anya: send signed note to Acme and paste thread.

sam: Acknowledged, updating tickets now.
